additional_info.body:
hi Emre-abi, good morning.
Thank you for the reply, indeed this is easier to troubleshoot. I will go one by one
2025-01-18T12:49:22.513Z :
2025-01-18T19:25:39.747Z :
2025-01-16T13:26:44.639Z
2025-01-16T13:16:08.884Z
2025-01-16T13:31:39.723Z
2025-01-16T13:30:10.227Z
No Start Transaction log, car plugged, A→B2 and failed authentication.
2025-01-18T19:30:01.863Z :
I've checked this random 7 sessions and I found that they are Starting the transaction in the wrong connector. For the other one there was no authentication provided. Since there are so many sessions that work and this charger is out of warranty, let me know if this answer is enough for you.
Best regards,
Francisco
